latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of "Thesis Literature Review Writer" skill.
- Generates detailed and academically rigorous Chinese literature review chapters or sections based on user inputs.
- Extracts thesis topic, research problem, variables, theory, method, and reference requirements from user prompts.
- Follows advanced synthesis workflow: organizes by variables, themes, mechanisms, or debates as appropriate to the research type.
- Drafts reviews using citation placeholders if references are not supplied, and recommends search terms.
- Ensures organization, critical evaluation, clear links to research questions, and adherence to formal Chinese academic writing standards.
